questions.question: Describe a web application you developed using AngularJS, Node.js, RESTful services, and JSON. How did you structure the UI, data flow, and error handling?

The role requires designing integrations using Salesforce APIs and third-party APIs. Based on your REST and AJAX experience, how would you approach integrating a web UI with Salesforce APIs while handling authentication, pagination, failures, and data mapping?
What is your experience conducting code reviews, and what specific issues do you look for in JavaScript, AngularJS, HTML, and CSS code?
You mention working in Agile and onsite-offshore testing models. How did you communicate requirements, defects, and implementation details across distributed teams?
Describe how you have deployed applications across development, test, and production environments. What controls or validation steps did you use before promoting a release?

This role involves translating solution architecture into implementation. How do you turn a high-level solution or business requirement into technical tasks, UI behavior, API contracts, and testable acceptance criteria?
Tell us about a challenging RESTful web-service or middleware integration you worked on. What was the issue, how did you investigate it, and what was the outcome?
How have you used Git or SVN for source control? Describe your approach to branching, pull or code reviews, resolving conflicts, and managing releases.
Describe a time you improved a responsive or cross-browser user experience. Which browsers or devices were affected, what changes did you make, and how did you validate the result?

What is your understanding of Salesforce Communications Cloud, Vlocity, OmniStudio, and telecom Quote-to-Cash processes, and how would your front-end and API integration experience apply to a solution in that environment?
